svg.title: From $1,875,000 Sales to $243,750 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-earnings-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: From $1,875,000 Sales to $243,750 Owner Net; subtitle: Six bars reconcile the Base-Case 13.0% annual net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Canonical annual outcomes: Conservative $750,000 sales at 8% equals $60,000 owner net; Base $1,875,000 at 13.0% equals $243,750; Scaled $3,000,000 at 18% equals $540,000. Expense allocations below are illustrative, not additional scorecard inputs. Net is after interest and before principal repayments; no separate owner-level income-tax calculation is supplied.; caption: Render sales as the opening total, four negative expense movements, and owner net as the closing total: $1,875,000 − $900,000 − $450,000 − $187,500 − $93,750 = $243,750. Do not add the closing total as another movement.; stages: label: Acquired-business sales; value: $1,875,000 annual recognized revenue; numeric value: 1875000.0; detail: Use earned sales from the operating company; exclude acquisition debt proceeds, equity contributions, sales tax collected for remittance, and purchase consideration.; label: Direct fulfillment costs; value: Subtract $900,000 annual direct costs; numeric value: -900000.0; detail: Allocate materials, outside fulfillment, and other direct costs here; exclude pod payroll already assigned below. The remaining gross profit is $975,000.; label: Recurring pod labor; value: Subtract $450,000 annual labor expense; numeric value: -450000.0; detail: Illustrative loaded labor and recurring contractor expense averages $37,500 monthly across the core pod; validate local wages, benefits, and contractor scope.; label: Other operating expense; value: Subtract $187,500 annual operating expense; numeric value: -187500.0; detail: Budget $15,625 monthly for occupancy, insurance, software, and remaining operating charges. Together with pod labor, recurring overhead is $53,125 monthly, excluding direct costs.; label: Interest expense; value: Subtract $93,750 annual interest expense; numeric value: -93750.0; detail: Interest averages $7,812.50 monthly in this allocation. Debt principal is not an earnings expense; model its cash requirement separately using actual amortization schedules.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $243,750 closing total; 13.0% margin; numeric value: 243750.0; detail: Divide $243,750 by $1,875,000 to recover 13.0%. Then separately bridge earnings to available cash for principal, working-capital changes, capex, and distributions.

rect.title: label: Acquired-business sales; value: $1,875,000 annual recognized revenue; numeric value: 1875000.0; detail: Use earned sales from the operating company; exclude acquisition debt proceeds, equity contributions, sales tax collected for remittance, and purchase consideration.

label: Direct fulfillment costs; value: Subtract $900,000 annual direct costs; numeric value: -900000.0; detail: Allocate materials, outside fulfillment, and other direct costs here; exclude pod payroll already assigned below. The remaining gross profit is $975,000.

label: Recurring pod labor; value: Subtract $450,000 annual labor expense; numeric value: -450000.0; detail: Illustrative loaded labor and recurring contractor expense averages $37,500 monthly across the core pod; validate local wages, benefits, and contractor scope.

label: Other operating expense; value: Subtract $187,500 annual operating expense; numeric value: -187500.0; detail: Budget $15,625 monthly for occupancy, insurance, software, and remaining operating charges. Together with pod labor, recurring overhead is $53,125 monthly, excluding direct costs.

label: Interest expense; value: Subtract $93,750 annual interest expense; numeric value: -93750.0; detail: Interest averages $7,812.50 monthly in this allocation. Debt principal is not an earnings expense; model its cash requirement separately using actual amortization schedules.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $243,750 closing total; 13.0% margin; numeric value: 243750.0; detail: Divide $243,750 by $1,875,000 to recover 13.0%. Then separately bridge earnings to available cash for principal, working-capital changes, capex, and distributions.

Expense allocations below are illustrative, not additional scorecard inputs. Net is after interest and before principal repayments; no separate owner-level income-tax calculation is supplied.
